description:
On or about April 10, 2026, a Request for Quote (RFQ) will be posted on SAM.gov. The RFQ will be for the fabrication of two (2) Tie Bolt (TB) Disposal Boxes for Norfolk Naval Shipyard (NNSY), Portsmouth, VA.

This requirement will result in a Firm‑Fixed‑Price award.

Please refer to the attachment for the description. Additional information will be provided with the RFQ.

Note: This is not a solicitation. Do not submit quotes or offers at this time.
